paper.$description: Page background in every product. Body text sits on it in `ink`.

paper-raised.$description: Cards, panels, dialogs and inputs that sit on `paper`.

paper-sunken.$description: Wells, table header rows, code blocks and quiet tag fills.

rule.$description: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

rule-strong.$description: Input and control borders. At least 3:1 on `paper` and `paper-raised` in both themes.

ink.$description: Headings and body text on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `paper-sunken`.

ink-soft.$description: Secondary text, descriptions and metadata on any paper ground.

ink-faint.$description: Placeholders, timestamps and captions on `paper` and `paper-raised`. Never for body copy.

focus.$description: The 2px focus ring on every interactive element, offset 2px. Solid, at least 3:1 on every paper ground.

success.$description: Success text and icons on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `success-bg`. Always paired with an icon and a word.

warning.$description: Warning text and icons on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `warning-bg`.

danger.$description: Error text, destructive buttons and invalid input borders on any paper ground and `danger-bg`.

info.$description: Informational text and icons on any paper ground and `info-bg`.
